_ignoreNote: The 'ignore' list is empty on purpose. It used to read ["mj_*"], a glob left over from the scaffold template that matches none of this repo's packages (they are all @mj-biz-apps/contracts-*). Changesets treats an ignore entry that resolves to nothing as a configuration ERROR, so every 'changeset status' and 'changeset version' run failed before it read a single changeset.
